key_highlights: ASX shed ~$90bn in one week as rate-rise fears and surging oil prices pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; oil price surge threatens to reignite inflation
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut timeline
Australia softened gas supply rules and sold out gas reservation, easing Asian energy fears (Santos impact)
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices falling sharply while affordable segment remains resilient
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior miners
Gold underperforming despite geopolitical tensions; Chinese inflation surging

sectors.trend: Sharp weakness. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge benefits energy names but weighs on broad mining. Junior miners raising capital under stress. Gold underperforming.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside on iron ore. Energy names (Santos, Woodside) supported by oil surge and gas policy easing. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) under pressure. Watch cap-raise dilution risk in juniors.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from rising bond yields and growth scare. RBA rental inflation concern delays rate-cut expectations. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation) adds political risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure if RBA holds rates. Rising yields support NIMs short-term but growth scare threatens credit quality. Super policy changes could alter fund flows.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as price suppression fails; fuel prices to rise 30c/L. Gas policy liberalisation (Santos preservation, gas reservation sold) supports domestic energy security narrative.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX), Origin (ORG.AX) benefit from oil/gas price tailwinds and policy support. Higher fuel costs feed into inflation, complicating RBA path.

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WOW.AX) caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promotion, eroding consumer trust. Business confidence deteriorating. Tax burden cited as key stressor.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin and sentiment pressure. Rising fuel and input costs squeeze household budgets, dampening discretionary spend.

sectors.trend: Housing bifurcation: high-end prices falling steeply, affordable segment resilient. RBA watching rental inflation. Property chiefs calling for more migrants to address supply gap.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals—rental inflation supports yields but affordability constraints limit tenant demand. High-end residential developers at risk.

sectors.trend: ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. US tech (Apple, AMD) showing strength. Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long test.
sectors.implications: Selective small-cap momentum. Battery/energy-storage names (CRB.AX) gaining credibility. US tech strength may support ASX-listed tech exposure.

key_themes: Oil price surge and fuel cost inflation as primary market driver
RBA rate path uncertainty driven by rental inflation
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 miners
AUD weakness on growth scare and commodity divergence
Gas policy liberalisation supporting energy sector
Chinese inflation and geopolitical tensions (Arctic shipping, ambassador comments)
Mining sector capital stress and dilution risk

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation resurgence delaying RBA rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate-sensitive sectors; favour fixed-income and dividend-paying defensives. Monitor RBA statements closely.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price deterioration pressuring ASX 200 miners
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore names; rotate into diversified miners or energy. Watch BHP.AX, FMG.AX guidance.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and growth scare triggering capital outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain AUD-hedged international exposure. Monitor AUD/USD and 10-yr GBA yields.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap-raise dilution and capital stress in juniors
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid undercapitalised juniors; favour well-funded explorers. Monitor Canaccord-led raises.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese inflation surge and geopolitical friction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-exposed commodity plays. Monitor PBOC response and trade flows.
Monitor political risk; favour large-cap financials with diversified revenue over super-dependent models.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy sector on oil surge and gas policy tailwinds
opportunities.rationale: Oil price explosion plus gas reservation liberalisation create multi-quarter earnings upside for integrated energy names
Critical Resources passing month-long test validates commercial viability; sector gaining credibility

opportunities.recommendation: Accumate quality dividend payers on ASX selloff
opportunities.rationale: $90bn ASX drawdown creates entry points for high-yield, low-beta names in banks and staples

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; structural demand concerns from China inflation and slowdown

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA rental inflation concern delays cuts, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-end residential REITs and developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls concentrated at top end; affordability constraints limit upside

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil-driven inflation and RBA hawkish tilt cap rate-cut expectations. Iron ore weakness continues to drag miners. Energy and defensives outperform. Volatility elevated on $90bn drawdown aftermath.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Gas policy reform supports energy earnings. Housing bifurcation may moderate. Super policy clarity would support financials. Key risk: sustained Chinese slowdown and AUD weakness.

Iron ore price trajectory and Chinese demand signals

RBA statements and rental inflation data
STO.AX, WDS.AX earnings and gas policy updates
Housing price indices (SQM, CoreLogic) by segment
